title: The 20% rule protects you, but only partly

hotspots.label: The rule
hotspots.detail: If the share of documents being deleted as stale exceeds 20%, deletion of those stale documents pauses for 7 days.

hotspots.label: Immediate deletions
hotspots.detail: To make deletions take effect immediately, use /processalldocuments. It is limited to one request every 3 hours per datasource.

hotspots.label: Below the threshold
hotspots.detail: A run that silently drops 8% of documents is under 20%, so those documents are deleted. The safeguard is not a completeness check.

hotspots.label: Empty runs
hotspots.detail: With the Indexing SDK, a successful empty full crawl sends one complete empty page, and all previously indexed documents are reconciled as stale.
